US Debates Livestreamed Execution of Fort Hood Shooter

The US military is reportedly considering a plan to execute Nidal Malik Hasan, responsible for the 2009 Fort Hood shooting, by firing squad and livestreaming the event on December 3, 2026. This proposed method has drawn criticism from various figures, including streamers HasanAbi, who called it "barbaric," and political figures from both Republican and Democratic parties. While former President Trump reportedly backs the firing squad and considers the death penalty a "worthy" execution, opposition to the livestreamed aspect has widened, with some Republicans and Democrats deeming the idea "beyond disgusting." The vice president has stated he will not watch such an event, and reports indicate countries around the world are considering blocking the livestream.
